anchor.label: thm:isometry
anchor.statement: \label{thm:isometry}\lean{Shape.isometry_classes} Let $\mu$ and $\nu$ be $\sigma$-finite measures and $\Phi \colon L^2(\mu \otimes \nu) \to \mathbb{R}^3$ a linear isometry. Every class $F$ has a representative, unique almost everywhere.

p.text: has a representative, unique almost everywhere.

links.doc:
On σ-finite measure spaces, a linear isometry from the square-integrable classes for the
product measure onto three-dimensional Euclidean space; each class has a representative, unique
almost everywhere for the product measure.
links.name: Shape.isometry_classes

exact.text:
∀ {Ω₁ Ω₂ : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω₁] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace Ω₂] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω₁)
  (ν : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω₂) [MeasureTheory.SigmaFinite μ] [MeasureTheory.SigmaFinite ν]
  (Φ : MeasureTheory.Lp ℝ 2 (μ.prod ν) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) (F : MeasureTheory.Lp ℝ 2 (μ.prod ν)),
  (↑Φ F).coords 0 = (↑Φ F).coords 0 ∧
    (∃ (g : Ω₁ × Ω₂ → ℝ),
        Filter.Eventually (fun (x : Ω₁ × Ω₂) => g x = F.toAEEqFun.cast x) (MeasureTheory.ae (μ.prod ν))) ∧
      ∀ (g h : Ω₁ × Ω₂ → ℝ),
        (MeasureTheory.ae (μ.prod ν)).EventuallyEq g F.toAEEqFun.cast →
          (MeasureTheory.ae (μ.prod ν)).EventuallyEq h F.toAEEqFun.cast → (MeasureTheory.ae (μ.prod ν)).EventuallyEq g h
